name: vscode-pdfviewer-secure
description: Open and preview PDF files in VS Code with security-first, offline-first defaults.

pdf-preview.default.cursor.markdownDescription: The default cursor tool for preview.

pdf-preview.default.scale.markdownDescription: The default zoom level for preview. Allowed values are `auto`, `page-actual`, `page-fit`, `page-width`, and 1-based scale values. (`1.0` means 100%)

pdf-preview.default.sidebar.markdownDescription: Show the sidebar on load. The default visibility of sidebar for preview.

pdf-preview.default.scrollMode.markdownDescription: The default scroll mode for preview.

pdf-preview.default.spreadMode.markdownDescription: The default spread mode for preview.

pdf-preview.features.externalLinks.markdownDescription: Allow external links embedded in PDFs or the bundled viewer UI.

pdf-preview.features.openFile.markdownDescription: Allow opening or importing another file through the PDF.js viewer.

pdf-preview.features.download.markdownDescription: Allow saving PDFs and opening or downloading their embedded attachments.

pdf-preview.features.print.markdownDescription: Allow print actions from the bundled PDF.js toolbar and shortcuts.

pdf-preview.features.documentProperties.markdownDescription: Allow access to the PDF document properties dialog.

pdf-preview.features.currentView.markdownDescription: Allow the secondary toolbar Current View link.

pdf-preview.features.forms.markdownDescription: Allow interactive PDF forms and XFA content.

pdf-preview.features.annotationEditing.markdownDescription: Allow PDF annotation editing controls such as highlight, ink, text, stamp, and signature tools.

pdf-preview.agent.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable PDF preview tools for agents such as Copilot in trusted local workspaces. Tools return the file path, loading status, and page count, without extracting PDF text.

languageModelTools.name: pdf_preview_open
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open a PDF in the PDF Viewer Secure editor and wait up to 30 seconds for its first page to render.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Open a PDF in the PDF Viewer Secure editor and wait up to 30 seconds for its first page to render. Requires pdf-preview.agent.enabled in User Settings and an existing .pdf file inside an open trusted local workspace. Accepts an absolute filesystem path, not a URL. Returns JSON with the canonical path and status (not_open, loading, loaded, or error); loaded includes pagesCount. Does not extract PDF text, images, annotations, or OCR. Do not use this tool to summarize PDF contents. A loading result may be checked later with pdf_preview_status.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path to an existing .pdf file inside an open workspace folder.

languageModelTools.name: pdf_preview_status
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get the current state of a PDF already open in PDF Viewer Secure without opening it or changing editor focus.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Get the current state of a PDF already open in PDF Viewer Secure without opening it or changing editor focus. Requires pdf-preview.agent.enabled in User Settings and an existing .pdf file inside an open trusted local workspace. Accepts an absolute filesystem path, not a URL. Returns JSON with the canonical path and status (not_open, loading, loaded, or error); loaded includes pagesCount. Does not extract PDF text, images, annotations, or OCR. Do not use this tool to summarize PDF contents. A loading result may be checked later with pdf_preview_status.

path.description: Absolute local filesystem path to an existing .pdf file inside an open workspace folder.
